# automox_data_extracts (Data Source)

Data extracts requested for the organization, such as API activity and patch history exports.

The download URL is deliberately not exposed. For a completed extract it is a pre-signed link to an export of the organization's data, and anything a data source returns is written to Terraform state in plaintext.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type` (String) Return only extracts of this kind, such as `api-activity` or `patch-history`.

### Read-Only

- `data_extracts` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_extracts))

<a id="nestedatt--data_extracts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data_extracts`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `download_expires_at` (String) When the export stops being downloadable.
- `end_time` (String) End of the period the extract covers.
- `id` (Number)
- `is_completed` (Boolean)
- `start_time` (String) Start of the period the extract covers.
- `status` (String) Automox's status, such as `expired` or `completed`.
- `type` (String)
- `user_id` (Number) The Automox user who requested the extract.
